title: Free-RBF-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Adaptive Radial Basis Functions for Efficient Function Learning
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) offer a promising framework for approximating complex nonlinear functions, yet the original B-spline formulation suffers from significant computational overhead due to De Boor algorithm. While recent RBF-based variants improve efficiency, they often sacrifice the approximation accuracy inherent in the original spline-based design. To bridge this gap, we propose Free-RBF-KAN, an architecture that integrates adaptive learning grids and trainable smoothness parameters to enable expressive, high-resolution function approximation.
